It was great joining @ScottforFlorida and Mayor @ChristiFraga at El Arepazo to hear directly from Floridians who know the value of freedom because they’ve lived without it. 

So many came to America after escaping socialist regimes, and they understand exactly what’s at stake in this election.

We’re going to keep Florida free, protect the Florida Dream, and make sure David Jolly’s socialist agenda never comes to the Free State of Florida.
